title: Marathon Coach, Inc.: BURNER TUBES/WEBASTO (155 affected)
summary: ON CERTAIN MOTOR HOMES BUILT ON PREVOST CHASSIS AND EQUIPPED WITH WEBASTO HEATERS, THE BURNER TUBES ARE MADE OF MATERIAL THAT DOES NOT MEET SPECIFICATIONS AND COULD FAIL PREMATURELY.

title: Mitsubishi Motors North America, Inc.: FRONT CROSSMEMBER (1,516 affected)
summary: ON CERTAIN PASSENGER VEHICLES, THE METAL FORMING PART OF THE FRONT CROSSMEMBER MAY HAVE BEEN IMPROPERLY STAMPED RESULTING IN THE METAL BECOMING THINNER IN THE CROSS-SECTION THAN SPECIFIED.  THIS COULD, OVER TIME, RESULT IN BREAKAGE OF THE CROSSMEMBER.

title: Dometic Corporation: REFRIGERATOR BURNER TUBE/FIRE (926,877 affected)
summary: CERTAIN DOMETIC TWO-DOOR REFRIGERATORS MANUFACTURED BETWEEN APRIL 1997 AND MAY 2003:  SERIAL NOS. 713XXXXX THROUGH 752XXXXX; 801XXXXX THROUGH 852XXXXX; 901XXXXX THROUGH 952XXXXX; 001XXXXX THROUGH 052XXXXX; 101XXXXX THROUGH 152XXXXX; 201XXXXX THROUGH 252XXXXX; 301XXXXX THROUGH 319XXXXX, INSTALLED IN CERTAIN RECREATIONAL VEHICLES AS ORIGINAL EQUIPMENT AND SOLD AS AFTERMARKET EQUIPMENT.  A FATIGUE CRACK MAY DEVELOP IN THE BOILER TUBE WHICH MAY RELEASE A SUFFICIENT AMOUNT OF PRESSURIZED COOLANT SOLUTION INTO AN AREA WHERE AN IGNITION SOURCE (GAS FLAME) IS PRESENT.

title: Chrysler (FCA US, LLC): POWERTRAIN CONTROL MODULE (4,770 affected)
summary: ON CERTAIN PASSENGER AND SPORT UTILITY VEHICLES AND PICKUP TRUCKS EQUIPPED WITH AUTOMATIC TRANSMISSIONS, THE SOFTWARE PROGRAMMED INTO THE POWERTRAIN CONTROL MODULE CAN CAUSE A MOMENTARY LOCK UP OF THE DRIVE WHEELS IF THE VEHICLE IS TRAVELING OVER 40 MPH AND THE OPERATOR SHIFTS FROM DRIVE TO NEUTRAL AND BACK TO DRIVE.

title: FTCA, Inc.: SPARE TIRE SUPPORT BRACKET (429 affected)
summary: CERTAIN TRAVEL TRAILERS MAY HAVE BEEN EQUIPPED WITH IMPROPERLY CONSTRUCTED SPARE TIRE SUPPORT BRACKETS THAT CAUSE THE SPARE TIRE TO HANG TOO LOW TO THE GROUND.

title: Mastercraft Boat Company, Inc.: 14 INCH WHEELS (174 affected)
summary: ON CERTAIN TANDEM-AXLE BOAT TRAILERS EQUIPPED WITH 14 INCH WHEELS, FAILURE OF THE WHEEL TO SEAT PROPERLY AND SECURELY ON THE WHEEL HUB CAN OCCUR.   THIS CAN CAUSE THE LUG NUTS TO BECOME LOOSE EVEN AFTER BEING TIGHTENED TO THE PROPER TORQUE SPECIFICATIONS.

title: Wilson Trailer Company: KING PIN SUPPORT BEAM ALUMINUM ANGLE (284 affected)
summary: ON CERTAIN GRAIN TRAILERS, A FATIGUE FAILURE (CRACKING) OF THE ALUMINUM ANGLE BEHIND THE KING PIN SUPPORT BEAM CAN OCCUR CAUSING DISTORTION OF THE BOTTOM RAIL AND COMPROMISING THE KING PIN ASSEMBLY.

title: NATIONAL RV, INC.: FUEL FILL GROUND CABLES (1,324 affected)
summary: CERTAIN MOTOR HOMES WERE NOT EQUIPPED WITH FUEL FILL GROUND CABLES.

title: Chrysler (FCA US, LLC): POWER OUTLET CONNECTOR (35,103 affected)
summary: ON CERTAIN SPORT UTILITY VEHICLES EQUIPPED WITH FRONT BENCH SEATS ONLY, IF FLUID IS SPILLED FROM THE FLOOR MOUNTED CUP HOLDER, AN UNUSED CONSOLE POWER OUTLET CONNECTOR LOCATED UNDER THE SEAT MAY BECOME CONTAMINATED.

title: ALFA LEISURE,INC.: FRONT AXLE TIE ROD THREAD ENGAGEMENT/FREIGHTLINER (311 affected)
summary: CERTAIN MOTOR HOMES BUILT ON FREIGHTLINER CHASSIS MAY HAVE BEEN MANUFACTURED WITH TIE RODS THAT ARE TOO SHORT FOR THE FRONT AXLE CROSSBAR TAPER.  THE RESULTING GAP BETWEEN THE CROSSBAR AND TIE ROD END MAY RESULT IN CORROSION BETWEEN THE 2 PIECES.  LACK OF MAINTENANCE WOULD INCREASE THE POSSIBILITY OF CORROSION.

title: Sure Power, Inc.: BATTERY EQUALIZERS - ELECTRICAL SHORT (401 affected)
summary: SURE POWER P/N 52210 24V/12V 100 AMP SERIES 1 BATTERY EQUALIZERS MANUFACTURED FROM OCTOBER 24, 2000, THROUGH APRIL 30, 2001, FOR USE ON CERTAIN NORTH AMERICA BUS INDUSTRIES (NABI) TRANSIT COACHES.  THESE EQUALIZERS USED AN INDUCTOR WITH THE COILS PROTECTED BY INSULATION.  OVER TIME, THE INDUCTOR INSULATION MAY DEGRADE CREATING A SHORT.

title: BEAMS INDUSTRIES, INC.: FMVSS 209/SEAT BELT ADJUSTER DOES NOT LOCK WEBBING (1,071 affected)
summary: CERTAIN BEAM'S SEAT BELT ASSEMBLIES, MODEL CH300, MANUFACTURED BETWEEN JUNE 22 AND JULY 17, 2006, SOLD AS REPLACEMENT EQUIPMENT FOR VARIOUS PASSENGER VEHICLES.  AN ASSEMBLY ERROR OCCURRED WITH AN ADJUSTER KNOWN AS BEAM'S PART NUMBER 303 ADJUSTER.  THE WEBBING PULLS THROUGH THE ADJUSTER WHEN IT SHOULD BE LOCKING UNDER LOAD.

title: WHITE RIVER MARINE GROUP LLC: FMVSS 110/CAPACITY TAGS INCORRECT (429 affected)
summary: CERTAIN BOAT TRAILERS FAIL TO CONFORM TO THE REQUIREMENTS OF FEDERAL MOTOR VEHICLE SAFETY STANDARD NO. 110, 'TIRE SELECTION AND RIMS.'  THE ORIGINAL CAPACITY TAG DISPLAYS AN INCORRECT WEIGHT CAPACITY FOR THE TRAILER.

title: Kia America, Inc.: STOP LAMP SWITCH WIRING HARNESS (4,753 affected)
summary: ON CERTAIN PASSENGER VEHICLES EQUIPPED WITH ADJUSTABLE BRAKE PEDALS, THE STOP LAMP SWITCH WIRING HARNESS MAY BE OUT OF POSITION.  AN IMPROPERLY POSITIONED STOP LAMP SWITCH WIRING HARNESS COULD MAKE CONTACT WITH THE U-JOINT ASSEMBLY OF THE STEERING COLUMN.  REPEATED CONTACT MAY EVENTUALLY CAUSE THE WIRING HARNESS INSULATION TO CHAFE.

title: Segway Inc. Announces Recall to Repair Segway® Personal Transporters
summary: The personal transporter can unexpectedly apply reverse torque to the wheels, which can cause a rider to fall. This can occur when the device is tilted back by the Speed Limiter and the rider comes off and then back onto the device within a short period of time. Units: About 23,500.

title: True Religion Recalls Children's Sweatshirts with Drawstrings Due to Strangulation Hazard; Sold Exclusively by Neiman Marcus
summary: A drawstring is threaded through the hood, posing a strangulation hazard to children. Units: About 150.

title: John Deere Gas Barbecue Grills Recalled Due to Fire, Burn Hazards
summary: Operating the grill in windy conditions can blow the flame under the control panel, causing the grill to overheat or cause flashbacks. Flames could damage the hose that supplies gas to the burner, causing an uncontrolled flame. Also, the grill's control knobs could overheat, resulting in burns to ha

title: Pride Products Recalls Counterfeit Extension Cords Due to Fire Hazard
summary: The counterfeit extension cords have undersized wiring and no fuse in the cord to provide over-current protection, which can cause overheating and pose a fire hazard. Units: About 42,000.

title: Pier 1 Imports Recalls TV Stands for Tipping Hazard
summary: If a consumer leans on the stand's drawer when open, the unit can tilt forward and cause a television on top to slide off, posing a risk of injury or death. Units: About 4,300.

title: Atico International USA Recalls 9-Foot Patio Umbrellas Sold at Longs Drug Stores for Lead Hazard
summary: The umbrella poles contain paint with excessive levels of lead, which can cause adverse health effects if ingested by young children. Units: About 27,700.

title: Delta Combination Water Heaters Recalled by Triangle Tube for Carbon Monoxide Poisoning Hazard
summary: The burner plate and flue hood seal on the water heaters can fail due to an improper seal causing a leak of flue gases and carbon monoxide (CO). This poses the risk of CO poisoning to consumers inside of the house. Units: About 3,000.

title: LeapFrog Recalls to Repair Children's Activity Centers Due to Arm Entrapment Hazard
summary: A child's arm can become caught in the activity center's plastic tube, posing a risk of injury to children. Units: About 186,000.

title: Olympus Expands March Recall of Overheating Infinity Film Cameras
summary: A defect with the flash circuit in these cameras can cause it to smoke and overheat, when the camera is turned on. This poses a possible burn hazard to consumers. Units: About 1.2 million (24,000 additional cameras).

title: Cervelo Cycles Inc. Announces Recall of Bicycles Due to Fall Hazard
summary: The bicycle frames can loosen or separate, causing the rider to lose control, fall and be injured. Units: About 650.

title: Lenovo and IBM Announce Recall of ThinkPad Notebook Computer Batteries Due to Fire Hazard
summary: These lithium-ion batteries can cause overheating, posing a fire hazard to consumers. Units: About 168,500 battery packs (an additional 357,500 battery packs were sold worldwide).

title: Kawasaki Motors Corp., U.S.A. Recalls MULE Utility Vehicles Due to Loss of Steering Hazard
summary: These vehicles could have been assembled with improperly manufactured steering knuckles that could break while the vehicle is in operation. This can cause a loss of steering control and cause a crash, resulting in injury or death. Units: About 400 units.

title: Suave Kids Bath Sets Sold at Wal-Mart Recalled for Choking, Other Hazards
summary: Items in the baths sets contain small parts that pose a choking hazard to young children. Additionally, some of the handles on the carrying case are long enough to pose a strangulation hazard. Also, the plastic carrying case poses a danger of suffocation. Units: About 11,000.

title: Playskool Voluntarily Recalls Toy Tool Benches after the Death of Two Toddlers
summary: The oversized plastic toy nails sold with the tool bench toys can become lodged in children's throats, posing a suffocation hazard. Units: About 255,000.

title: Advantus Corp. Recalls Desk Lamps Due to Burn Hazard
summary: The plastic near the bulb of these lamps can overheat and melt. This poses a burn hazard to consumers who could touch the hot plastic. Units: About 1,000.

title: Gildan Activewear Recalls Youth Hooded Sweatshirts with Drawstrings for Strangulation Hazard
summary: These sweatshirts have a drawstring through the hood, posing a strangulation hazard to children. Units: 114,000.

title: LEGO Recalls Toy Trucks Due to Puncture Hazard to Young Children
summary: The plastic wheels on the truck can detach, exposing a metal axle. This poses a puncture hazard to young children. Units: About 358,000.

title: The Cayre Group Recalls Hooded Sweatshirts with Drawstrings Sold at Kohl's for Strangulation Hazard
summary: These sweatshirts have a drawstring through the hood, posing a strangulation hazard to children. Units: About 4,500.

title: Arctic Cat Inc. Recalls Snowmobiles Due to Loss of Steering Control Hazard
summary: The steering shaft used on certain 2002, 2003, 2004, 2005 and 2006 Arctic Cat snowmobiles can fail at the steering shaft/steering arm attachment. This could cause a loss of steering control of the vehicle, and result in injury or death. Units: About 50,500.

title: Children's Bathrobes Sold at Ross Stores Recalled Due to Burn Hazard
summary: These bathrobes fail to meet the children's sleepwear flammability standard, and pose a burn hazard. Units: About 740.

title: Drinking Glasses Sold by QVC Recalled Due to Laceration Hazard
summary: The inner walls of the double-walled glasses can break during use, posing a laceration hazard to consumers. Units: About 2,200 sets of four glasses.

title: Regal Lager Inc. Recalls Travel Cots Due to Choking Hazard
summary: The plastic caps on the corner connectors can come loose, posing a small parts choking hazard to young children. Units: About 1,000.

title: Fire Hazard Prompts Canon U.S.A. to Recall Previous Model Desktop Copiers for Repair
summary: An improperly fitting electrical connection inside the copiers can cause overheating, smoking and fire. Units: About 800,000.
